description.value: A Co-op convenience store and fuel station operating under the Husky brand in Kitimat, offering vehicle fuel including diesel alongside convenience store goods. Part of the Four Rivers Co-op network, these community-owned co-operatives serve northern BC with a range of retail services. For a touring cyclist, this is a practical roadside stop for basic resupply in a community with limited service options.

The discovered website (fourriversco-op.crs) confirms Four Rivers Co-op operates fuel, food, vending, and propane services across northern BC, but Kitimat is not listed among its stated service communities — raising a potential mismatch between the OSM record and the website's stated coverage area. No cyclist-specific amenity details (bike parking, water, etc.) are available from either source, though the shop=convenience tag provides positive evidence for basic convenience goods.
concerns: Kitimat is not listed among the Four Rivers Co-op service communities on the website (listed communities include Terrace, Prince George, Quesnel, Vanderhoof, etc., but not Kitimat) — the discovered website URL may not correspond to this specific OSM location.
